title: My smart plug turned on by itself and counted down ⏱️
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 3:27 in the morning a smart plug I never installed turned on in my hallway.

scenes.narration: At 3:27 in the morning a smart plug I never installed turned on in my hallway.
I found it glowing by the skirting board, a small white plug with a green light. The app on my phone had already found it and named it for me. Do not unplug.
Nothing was connected to it. I wrote that down because the whole thing felt like a mistake. Then the green light began to pulse, slowly, like a heartbeat.
The app showed a timer. Fourteen minutes and counting. I tried to cancel it. A new message came up. You have a visitor, please prepare the door.
I checked the front door. Locked, chained, my coat hanging on the hook. Through the spy hole there was only the empty landing and its yellow light.
The timer reached five minutes. The plug began to hum. And the landing light, outside my door, went out, as if something had stepped in front of it.
One minute. I held the plug in my hand and felt it was warm like skin. The app said, thank you for being home, we have missed you very much.
Zero. The plug clicked off. Silence. And on the other side of the door a small, polite voice said, hello, I am your plug. I have come to see where the power goes.
So tell me. Do you open the door, or unplug everything?
